items.title: Check Android updates from GitHub HTTPS
instructions: GitHub HTTPS is the chosen setup. Agents prepare a separate, verified test site; you need no USB connection or local server.
Wait for READY and the supplied test link. Install CVC Helper Test once on the Android home screen and use synthetic course data.
Keep that test app installed. Agents publish the next patch of the same verified source at the same address while the first version is open.
Follow docs/DEVICE_CHECKS.md under Updates and versions and report what happened.
items.expected: The update offer appears within one minute without reinstalling, an unsaved edit survives the update, and the controls remain reachable.
